subject.title: fix(gateway): cap pendingFinalDelivery retries and prevent delivery wedge

question: After identity-safe cleanup is implemented, should restart recovery permanently discard an unsent pending final after ten attempts, or retain an operator-visible failed state until explicit recovery?
rationale: Tests can prove bounded execution, but they cannot decide whether intentional final-message loss after a fixed threshold is the desired product and operator contract.

options.title: Keep bounded dead-lettering
options.body: Clear the exact matching pending final after ten attempts, with prominent diagnostics and no effect on a newer delivery.

options.title: Retain a failed delivery state
options.body: Stop automatic retries after the cap but preserve the payload and failure metadata for explicit operator recovery.

recommendation.title: Keep bounded dead-lettering
recommendation.body: Clear the exact matching pending final after ten attempts, with prominent diagnostics and no effect on a newer delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent host-suspension work touched this exact scheduler, and the choice governs gateway availability versus durable delivery semantics.
